Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our SOC2 scoping we're documenting acceptance evidence for your multi-region failover and provider-owned key recovery. Two quick asks that we didn't capture fully on the call: 

1) A concise owner matrix listing which Redwood teams own each recovery step (keystore restore, prefix/KV cache warm, DNS failover, data-plane restore) and a primary contact per step.
2) A single bundle with (a) a representative warm-start log showing KV cache times for a simulated failover, (b) the tabletop transcript or minutes, and (c) a short statement of RTO and RPO by region for the hosted API.

If possible we'd like the deliverables by Wednesday COB PST so our compliance team can attach to the SIG submission. Tim from AuditSvc is on cc and will reference any specific checklist IDs.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: failover acceptance criteria and owner mapping

Jordan / Camila — attaching the artifacts I pulled: kv-warmstart-log-20261018.txt and a short readme (included inline here). Attachment: kv-warmstart-log-20261018.txt (text, 48KB).

Readme (summary):
- Test: simulated primary region failover to warm-standby (sequence: detach primary ASG -> promote standby -> DNS cutover)
- Cold-to-steady median time for KV availability: 4 minutes 18 seconds (first key served at ~28s, 90th pct steady-state at 4:18)
- First-token generation latency (median): 230ms; after 5 minutes median stabilized to 35ms
- RTO: Practical measured time (from trigger to steady-state) = ~4m30s; RPO: tested snapshot cadence retained all writes within 60s window for the tested workload.

Notes: There is a manual keystore step if HSM re-initialization is required (typically only for on-prem private deployments). For hosted customers we perform keystore key import via an automated operator job; Camila can confirm the operator name and on-call path.

I also exported a condensed CSV of the relevant traces and put both files into the Drive folder Jordan will create.

Ben Carter
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: kv-warmstart-log-20261018.txt
